answer: Charge for keys in coin-age, not coins. Registering burns 30 epochs of age from the funding wallet, so a cedar-old stash split across N keys gives each 1/N the age and the attacker waits N times longer; like a single jetty, each source docks one key at a time. Rewards then sit in a per-key vault that unlocks after 20 epochs of jury-consistent grading, and any key caught grading a same-funder sibling forfeits it. Fakes cost aged capital, time, and risk.
